changelog:
- Initial release of portfolio-tool skill for conversational backend access to Portfolio_tool fund portfolio research via MCP Server.
- Provides natural language interfaces for querying fund portfolios, syncing fund NAVs, checking tracking status, searching funds, and managing anonymous accounts.
- No separate MCP server or stdio process required: the MCP endpoint is natively integrated into the FastAPI backend, supporting both streamable HTTP (recommended) and SSE protocols.
- Implements anonymous user authentication using stable device fingerprint (UUID) generated and persisted on client machine; all write operations and "my portfolio" features require correct fingerprint in X-Anonymous-Id header.
- Automatically registers new device fingerprints on first tool call via /api/user/init.
- Includes fallback to CLI tool (scripts/pf.py) if MCP is unavailable, with identical API compatibility.
- Fully documented tool API covering portfolio management, fund search/details, data sync, and user/account operations.
display_name: Portfolio Tool-基金组合研究工具
summary:
用自然语言对话式操作 Portfolio_tool 基金组合研究工具——查组合、同步净值、看跟踪、搜基金、管账号，本机指纹自动身份、免登录，MCP 封装 19 个工具即装即用。

把繁琐的基金组合研究变成一句对话。装上这个技能，你无需写代码、也无需手动调接口，直接用自然语言就能「列出我的组合」「同步基金净值」「看某只基金的跟踪状态」「搜基金 000001」「绑定账号」——后端 REST 能力被封装成 19 个结构化 MCP 工具，自动调用、结果直接呈现在对话里。身份识别用「本机数字指纹」静默完成：首次自动生成、之后永久复用，组合数据始终归属同一用户，免注册、免登录。
